bio_md:
# 元仁宗爱育黎拔力八达 · 主要事迹

孛儿只斤爱育黎拔力八达（1285—1320），武宗之弟，自幼受汉学教育，精通儒术。至大四年（1311）武宗崩，践「兄终弟及」之约即位，改元皇庆。

仁宗一朝号为贤主：皇庆二年（1313）恢复科举，延祐二年（1315）首开科取士；又译经史、兴文教，汉化政策推进。然仁宗晚年背弃与武宗之约，不立武宗之子而传位于己子硕德八剌（[[yuan-ying-zong|英宗]]），为后来天历之变伏下根由。

延祐七年（1320）仁宗崩，英宗即位。兄弟之约坏于传子，元朝中衰自此。

bio_parts_en.value:
Borjigin Ayurbarwada (1285-1320), younger brother of Wuzong, was schooled in Confucian learning from youth. When Wuzong died in 1311 he took the throne by the brother-succession pact, era Huangqing.

Renzong's reign was praised: he restored the examinations in 1313, held the first Yuan session in 1315, commissioned translations of the classics, and pressed the Sinicization of government. But in his later years he broke the pact with his brother, setting aside Wuzong's sons to pass the throne to his own son Shidibala (

) - the root of the Tianli storms.

He died in 1320. The broken pact ended the Yuan's middle peace.
